source_en: Hello, brother. Grim morning, but we're still here. Father Shota Eradze.
I've been out since dawn fixing water lines in the east district.
People need water before they need prayer. I work in that order.
The body tires. The purpose doesn't.
I keep my papers beside a parishioner's letter. She thanked me for a talk.
Grief and fear sound different from outside. Inside, they feel the same.
Peace is chosen each morning. Today it was easier than yesterday.
Three brothers left at the seminary. We still visit every family.
